rules.statement: The 10th defendant, who is the adhikari of Kovilakanda Purana Viharaya, should be recognized as having a legal right to represent the temple in an assertion to sanghika property.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the limited purposes of the present case, points of dispute Nos. 4, 5, 9 and 10 should, in my opinion, have been answered in favour of the 10th defendant, while point of dispute No. 8 should have been answered in favour of the temple."

meta.parties: Baddegama Sri Ratnasara Thera v. Basheer
